extensionAttribute.description: Reports which local users have been SmartCard-paired and the card identifier.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # SmartCard Paired Users Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon # sc_auth identities is the canonical lookup on every supported macOS.
out=$(/usr/sbin/sc_auth identities 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/awk '/^[[:space:]]*[0-9A-F]/ { sub(/^[[:space:]]+/, ""); print }')
if [[ -z "$out" ]]; then echo "<result>No Users have been SmartCard enabled</result>" else echo "<result>${out}</result>" fi
